# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Repository | Version | Supported |
|-|-|-|
| app | 0.0.x | True |
| css | 0.1.x | True |
| context-engine | 0.1.x | True |
| flair | 0.1.x | True |
| rectgrid | 0.4.x | True |
| rectgrid | < 0.4 | False |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report a vulnerability via below URL:

- https://github.com/animagram-jp/app/security/advisories/new
- https://github.com/animagram-jp/css/security/advisories/new
- https://github.com/animagram-jp/context-engine/security/advisories/new
- https://github.com/animagram-jp/flair/security/advisories/new
- https://github.com/animagram-jp/rectgrid/security/advisories/new

## Disclosure Policy

- Report a vulnerability only through the URLs above. Do not open a public issue for it.
- The maintainer acknowledges a report within 14 days.
- The maintainer and the reporter agree on a disclosure date. The default is the release date of the fix, and it is no later than 90 days after the report.
- A fix is released for the supported versions listed above.
- The advisory credits the reporter unless the reporter declines.

## Published Vulnerabilities

Fixed vulnerabilities are published as GitHub Security Advisories of each repository:

- https://github.com/animagram-jp/app/security/advisories
- https://github.com/animagram-jp/css/security/advisories
- https://github.com/animagram-jp/context-engine/security/advisories
- https://github.com/animagram-jp/flair/security/advisories
- https://github.com/animagram-jp/rectgrid/security/advisories
